mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous 0.5% monthly increase in employment (PAYEMS) and 0.2 percentage point decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 0.5% and UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of simultaneous PAYEMS rise and UNRATE fall are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, a housing starts level below 1300 thousand units (HOUST < 1300) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in late-cycle periods with HOUST < 1300 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production level above 105 (INDPRO > 105) indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profitability, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in high INDPRO periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous 1% monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) and 0.5% monthly increase in retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 1% and RSAFS rises > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of simultaneous HOUST and RSAFS rise are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly acceleration in the CPI index exceeding 0.3% (CPIAUCSL > 0.3% monthly change) signals inflationary pressures that prompt aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high CPIAUCSL change periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate below 3.0% (UNRATE < 3.0%) indicates a tight labor market that fuels wage growth and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in low UNRATE periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
